summary: Strong, well-structured end-to-end solution following GitHub Actions best practices (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, proper job dependencies). Workflow correctly uses environment variables and graceful error handling (set +e pattern). license_checker.py has clean separation of concerns, proper error handling, and hermetic design (injected license-db). run_act_tests.py provides comprehensive fixture-driven validation via act. Minor gaps: (1) Python lacks type hints, (2) PyYAML dependency not documented (required by run_act_tests.py for YAML parsing), (3) JSON output parsing in run_act_tests.py (lines 240–255) relies on specific act output formatting and brace-balancing heuristic—fragile if act changes output format. All three issues are addressable. Workflow should execute correctly in act; no script dependencies missing from ubuntu-latest image.
